stem: An experiment was carried out to determine the percentage of iron in a sample of iron wire.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: A $3.35\text{ g}$ piece of the wire was reacted with dilute sulfuric acid, in the absence of air, so that all of the iron atoms were converted to iron(II) ions. The resulting solution was made up to $250\text{ cm}^3$.
parts.text: Write a balanced equation for the reaction between the iron in the wire and the sulfuric acid.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.stem:
A $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ sample of this solution was acidified and titrated with $0.0250\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ potassium dichromate(VI). $32.0\text{ cm}^3$ of the potassium dichromate(VI) solution was required for complete reaction with the iron(II) ions in the sample.

The relevant half-equations are shown.

$$\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-} + 14\text{H}^+ + 6\text{e}^- \rightarrow 2\text{Cr}^{3+} + 7\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

$$\text{Fe}^{2+} \rightarrow \text{Fe}^{3+} + \text{e}^-$$
parts.text: Use the half-equations to write an equation for the reaction between the iron(II) ions and the acidified dichromate(VI) ions.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Calculate the amount, in moles, of dichromate(VI) ions used in the titration.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text: Calculate the amount, in moles, of iron(II) ions in the $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ sample of solution.

parts.label: (a)(v)
parts.text: Calculate the amount, in moles, of iron in the $3.35\text{ g}$ piece of wire.

parts.label: (a)(vi)
parts.text: Calculate the mass of iron in the $3.35\text{ g}$ piece of wire.

parts.label: (a)(vii)
parts.text: Calculate the percentage of iron in the iron wire.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Some electronegativity values are shown.

| element | electronegativity |
| :--- | :--- |
| aluminium | 1.5 |
| chlorine | 3.0 |
| iron | 1.8 |
parts.text: Use the data to suggest the nature of the bonding in iron(III) chloride. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest an equation for the reaction between iron(III) chloride and water.
